name: Shielded Nakas
description:
3,333 Shielded Nakas. Public art, private owners.

The art is inscribed on Bitcoin. Ownership lives in your shielded vault on Ord Dropz, so after the mint nobody can see who holds a piece or where it moves. Paying and receiving BTC stays visible; holding and moving are private.

Mint: Thursday, Oct 1 · 8 AM PT / 15:00 UTC.

GTD for the first 2 hours, up to 2 per wallet, for Rare Gummies holders, Lil Wiggles holders and the Top 150. FCFS is open at the same time. Unminted GTD pieces go to FCFS after the 2 hours.

Tradable on Ord Dropz from day one.
